mainline_contract.target: WT = raw labels {1,2,3}; raw label 4 excluded
mainline_contract.click_protocol: three accumulated GT-derived corrective clicks with recurrent low-resolution mask prompt
mainline_contract.stage1: braincrop SAM-Med3D automatic localization remains unchanged
mainline_contract.stage2: native 128^3 SAM-Med3D crop and click-3 checkpoint remains frozen
mainline_contract.global_refiner: frozen epoch-58 T1ce plus SAM-logit SegResNet residual refiner
forbidden: validation grid search over patch size or click heatmap width

evidence_before_registration.interpretation: lesion size is the clearest remaining within-mainline bottleneck; a prompt-centred high-resolution local residual is a direct fixed-geometry test

hypothesis: A fixed local residual model centred on the first positive corrective click will preserve the frozen global prediction outside the prompted neighbourhood while improving small-lesion delineation inside it.

arm.name: t1ce_wt_prompt_local64_globalresidual_v1
arm.crop: one fixed 64x64x64 cube centred on the frozen first positive click and clamped to the 128^3 stage-2 grid
input_channels: maximum Gaussian heatmap of accumulated positive clicks
maximum Gaussian heatmap of accumulated negative clicks
arm.prediction: global-refiner raw logit plus a learned residual inside the 64^3 cube; global-refiner logit unchanged outside
arm.zero_initialization: the final local-residual convolution is zero, so epoch 0 must exactly reproduce the frozen global full-scan DSC
arm.backbone: MONAI SegResNet, init_filters=16, blocks_down=[1,2,2,4], blocks_up=[1,1,1], dropout=0.1
arm.loss: local-cube DiceCE(sigmoid=true, squared_pred=false, equal Dice/CE weights)
arm.optimizer: AdamW(lr=2e-4, weight_decay=1e-5), gradient norm clipped to 5
arm.sampling: deterministic distributed replacement sampling weighted by clipped sqrt(median lesion volume / lesion volume), range [0.5,4]
arm.augmentation: joint axis flips of all four inputs and target; T1ce-only scale, offset, and Gaussian noise
arm.selection: maximum 108-case validation full-scan macro DSC; outside-cube counts remain frozen

gates.cache_integrity: two A100 shards must merge into exactly 972 train and 108 validation rows in frozen source-cache order with every binary hash verified
gates.same_hardware_baseline: A100 cached global-refiner full-scan validation DSC must be finite and recorded; cross-hardware H100 variation is contextual only
gates.engineering_smoke: two DDP epochs complete with finite loss, epoch-0 delta exactly zero, checkpoint written and both GPUs participating
gates.automatic_cascade_gate: only if development_success passes, evaluate this frozen local refiner under stage-1-predicted crop geometry on validation
gates.test_gate: no sealed-test access without a separate frozen automatic-cascade configuration and new explicit user authorization

prediction_registered_before_run.reason: the geometry concentrates capacity at the prompted lesion and preserves the strong global solution outside, but the seven worst cases may be intrinsically ambiguous on T1ce and the train-time GT-centred stage-2 geometry remains oracle
